qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant ~70% market share in reverse vending machines (RVM) and optical sorting, but powerful grocery retailers resist price increases, compressing margins during inflationary periods.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Pricing Power, REJECT). Despite dominant reverse-vending market share, grocery retailers treat RVMs as an unwanted regulatory compliance cost and fiercely resist price increases. Operating margins collapsed from 14.2% in 2021 to 7.8% in 2023 under component and wage inflation, demonstrating lack of pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.evidence: EBIT margins fell from 14.2% (2021) to 11.9% (2022) and 7.8% (2023) due to cost inflation and inability to pass prices through to grocery retail clients. Demand is subject to cyclical delays in government deposit return scheme (DRS) mandates.
